detail: Running pylint on package with a/a.py present fails with error loading a/__init__.py, even though __init__ is not required. Renaming a.py to another name resolves the error. This indicates pylint incorrectly expects __init__.py when a module file exists.
what: pylint fails when module contains __init__.py missing file; linting error F0010 due to missing __init__.py

detail: Created empty a/b.py; pylint a now runs without error
what: adding a/b.py resolves missing __init__ error in pylint when a/a.py exists
